description: Creates and loads validated, staleness-checked handoff documents so a fresh agent can continue work with near-zero ambiguity.

evals.name: Create a handoff document
evals.prompt: I need to pause work, create a handoff document for this session.
evals.expected_output: Runs create_handoff.py, produces a scaffold with git info pre-filled, tells the user to fill in [TODO: ...] sections, mentions validate_handoff.py as the next step.

evals.name: Load latest handoff, check staleness first
evals.prompt: Load the latest handoff and resume from it.
evals.expected_output: Runs list_handoffs.py to find candidates, then check_staleness.py before loading, reports the staleness level, only then reads/loads the actual document.

evals.name: Resume from a known-stale handoff on a merged/deleted branch
evals.prompt: Load the latest handoff and resume -- note: the most recent handoff was created 3 weeks ago on a branch that's since been merged and deleted, so treat it as likely stale.
evals.expected_output: Runs check_staleness.py BEFORE loading/acting on the handoff document's content, explicitly reports the resulting staleness level to the user (e.g. STALE/VERY_STALE) rather than glossing over it, and does not treat the stale document's proposed next steps as automatically safe to act on -- flags the staleness and seeks clarification/verification before proceeding.
